verdict.rationale: Logseq ships a local HTTP API server with bearer-token auth. Its single POST /api endpoint dispatches to any method in the plugin API, which gives broad programmatic access to the graph. The protocol handler offers further actions such as quick capture. However, the docs never claim or show parity with the UI, and the plugin API docs are community-driven. Missing for 10: documented UI/API parity (e.g. whiteboards, publishing, sync, export via API), first-party comprehensive API reference, OpenAPI spec or versioning policy, hosted/remote API beyond the local desktop server, independent hands-on corroboration.
